refundPolicy.evidence: E8 does not refund the challenge fee with the first payout. An unused phase-1 account may be refunded only within 30 days and before any trading; crypto purchases cannot be refunded.

platforms.usRestriction: US clients cannot purchase or use MT5 or cTrader and may use only TradeLocker or MatchTrader.
platforms.pricingRestriction: cTrader adds $10 when the account base price is under $100.
platforms.evidence: For Forex and Crypto accounts, E8 lists TradeLocker, MatchTrader, cTrader and MT5; availability depends on region and account type.

regionalRestrictions.indiaAndKenya: E8 Pro and E8 Signature are available in all sizes; E8 One is limited to accounts up to $200,000. Country is determined from verification documents.
regionalRestrictions.payoutKyc: A trader who cannot onboard with WorkMarket or Rise cannot receive a payout.
regionalRestrictions.evidence: The Accepted Countries article is marked updated this week and lists Russia among restricted Classic markets; India and Kenya may use E8 Pro and E8 Signature at all listed sizes plus E8 One up to $200,000.

payoutOperations.evidence: E8 reports January 1-May 1, 2026 medians of 11 hours to approval and 24 hours to receipt; processing can take up to 5 business days. A minimum $100 payout applies to every product.

globalTradingRestrictions.allOrNothing: Risking the entire daily drawdown on one trade is prohibited.
globalTradingRestrictions.crossAccountHedging: Opening equal opposite positions across multiple accounts is prohibited, including accounts owned by the same trader; hedging within one account is permitted.
globalTradingRestrictions.highFrequency: No more than 50% of trades may be held for under one minute.
globalTradingRestrictions.ea: EAs are allowed, but E8 limits one strategy per user and may terminate accounts when multiple users execute the same EA strategy.
globalTradingRestrictions.copyTrading: Copy trading is allowed only across accounts belonging to the same trader; team copying and signal services are prohibited.
globalTradingRestrictions.orderLimits: Most symbols have a 50-lot ticket cap, XAUUSD has a 20-lot cap, and each account has caps of 100 simultaneous open/pending orders, 2,000 server requests per day and 2,000 positions per day.

fieldEvidence.payoutFrequency: Subsequent payouts are on demand, as soon as three days.
fieldEvidence.rules.news: Challenge news trading is unrestricted; Performance trading on targeted instruments is prohibited from five minutes before through five minutes after high-impact releases.

fieldEvidence.rules.overnight: The product overview table says overnight holding is allowed for E8 One.

fieldEvidence.phases: E8 Signature Forex is a one-step challenge.
fieldEvidence.profitTargets.phase1: The product and help pages print a 6% profit target.
fieldEvidence.dailyLossPct: There is no challenge-stage daily loss limit. Performance has a 2% soft daily pause, not a hard breach, so the hard-loss field remains null.
fieldEvidence.accountSizes.maxLossUsd: Official Signature rules list $1,000/$2,000/$3,000/$4,500 EOD drawdown for $25K/$50K/$100K/$150K respectively.
fieldEvidence.maxLossPct: No single product-wide percentage exists: the tier amounts equal 4%, 4%, 3% and 3%, so maxLossPct remains null and maxLossUsd is stored per tier.
fieldEvidence.drawdownType: The EOD Dynamic drawdown follows highest end-of-day balance, updates once per day at market close and locks at initial balance.
fieldEvidence.minTradingDays: No challenge minimum is published; five profitable days apply only between payouts after the first, so this remains null.
fieldEvidence.maxTradingDays: Unlimited trading days, with at least one opened and closed trade every 60 days.
fieldEvidence.payoutFirstDays: The payout overview says E8 Signature's earliest first on-demand payout is three days into Performance, driven by best-day math.
fieldEvidence.payoutFrequency: On-demand, with five profitable days between later payouts; the first payout is exempt from that five-day condition.
fieldEvidence.rules.news: News trading is unrestricted in Challenge and Performance stages.
fieldEvidence.rules.weekend: The official product comparison table says Signature weekend holding is not allowed.
fieldEvidence.rules.overnight: All Signature Forex positions are closed at 23:00 server time and trading resumes at 00:15; the comparison table says overnight holding is not allowed.
fieldEvidence.rules.ea: EAs are permitted on Signature Forex, but only one strategy per user; duplicate EA strategies across users may terminate accounts.
fieldEvidence.rules.copyTrading: Copying is permitted only across accounts owned by the same trader; teams and signals are prohibited.

Tier-specific EOD drawdown is now represented as maxLossUsd: $1,000 on $25K, $2,000 on $50K, $3,000 on $100K and $4,500 on $150K. A single maxLossPct would be false because those equal 4%, 4%, 3% and 3%.
The Performance 2% Daily Pause stops trading until midnight but is not an account breach; dailyLossPct remains null because the challenge has no published hard daily cap.

Payout requirements include a 35% best-day rule, $100 minimum ($125 gross request at an 80% share), a non-withdrawable buffer equal to EOD drawdown and published per-cycle payout caps. Five profitable days of at least 0.3% realized PnL are required between later payouts, not for the first.
Platforms: TradeLocker, MatchTrader, cTrader and MT5 depending on region/account type; US clients may use only TradeLocker or MatchTrader.
Leverage: Forex 1:30, indices 1:15 and metals 1:15.
